title: Native Peoples
questionReadAloudEn: Who lived in North America before settlers took it over?

title: English Settlement Reasons
questionReadAloudEn: What are two reasons people from England moved to North America?
answerReadAloudEn: To make money. To have their own religion.

title: Colony
answerReadAloudEn: A colony is territory that is controlled by another country.

title: Original Colony Regions
questionReadAloudEn: Label the three regions of the original colonies.
answerReadAloudEn: The three regions are New England, Middle, and Southern.

title: Regional Economies
questionReadAloudEn: How did the Northern and Southern regions make money?
answerReadAloudEn: The North made money with industry. The South made money with agriculture.

title: Slavery
answerReadAloudEn: Slavery is a system where one person owns and controls another person.

title: Thirteen Colonies Control
questionReadAloudEn: What country controlled the Thirteen Colonies?

title: Declaration of Independence
questionReadAloudEn: What was the Declaration of Independence?
answerReadAloudEn: The Declaration of Independence was the official document that announced the thirteen colonies separated from Britain.

title: American Revolution Cause
questionReadAloudEn: What was the American Revolution fought over?
answerReadAloudEn: The colonists wanted independence from Britain and to have their own government.

title: American Revolution Events
questionReadAloudEn: Name an important event that happened during the American Revolution.
answerReadAloudEn: Important events included the Boston Massacre, the Boston Tea Party, and Paul Revere’s Ride.

title: After the Revolution
questionReadAloudEn: What happened after the colonists won the American Revolution?
answerReadAloudEn: They created a new country called the United States of America.
